fields: a grid block (h, intro, items [{t, d, link, station}]) or a table block (h, intro, cols, rows: the first cell is the card title, the others are labelled with their column name).
best_for: ShopFloor places the company's people or roles where their work happens, as numbered stations on one isometric plan of the shop with a walking route through them, so a reader sees the shop and who works where before reading the cards.
